name: Kouzuki Emika
source:
She is Norikazu’s childhood friend. They are the same age and they grew up together in the town where they were both born.
She lost her parents a few years ago and is being raised by her stepfather.
Around that time, her true personality—a sweet and cheerful nature—began to emerge.

In fact, she had been subjected to sexual abuse by her stepfather for some time, but she kept this a secret from Norikazu.
When Norikazu invited her to leave town, she initially refused, but after he strongly persuaded her, she decided to leave with him.
She is afraid of becoming a burden to Norikazu.
